title: Zebra wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <clipPath id='head'>
      <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='22' ry='26'/>
    </clipPath>
  </defs>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='34' rx='5' ry='9' fill='#f2f2f2'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='34' rx='5' ry='9' fill='#f2f2f2'/>
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='35' rx='2.5' ry='5.5' fill='#c9c9d9'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='35' rx='2.5' ry='5.5' fill='#c9c9d9'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='22' ry='26' fill='#f8f8ff'/>
  <!-- stripes -->
  <g clip-path='url(#head)' fill='#3a3a5c'>
    <rect x='28' y='40' width='44' height='5' rx='2.5'/>
    <rect x='28' y='50' width='44' height='5' rx='2.5'/>
    <rect x='28' y='60' width='44' height='5' rx='2.5'/>
    <rect x='28' y='70' width='44' height='5' rx='2.5'/>

  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='15' ry='11' fill='#e9dcc9'/>

  <ellipse cx='43' cy='76' rx='2' ry='2.6' fill='#8a6f5a'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='76' rx='2' ry='2.6' fill='#8a6f5a'/>

  <path d='M44 82 Q50 87 56 82' stroke='#8a6f5a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='57' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='57' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='57' r='3' fill='#3a3a5c'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='57' r='3' fill='#3a3a5c'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='55.5' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='55.5' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- party hat -->
  <path d='M34 30 L50 4 L66 30 Z' fill='#ff5fa2'/>
  <path d='M38 24 L50 24 M41 17 L50 17 M44 10 L50 10' stroke='#ffd23f' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='4' r='4' fill='#3ec6ff'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='30' rx='16' ry='3.5' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <!-- hat stripes overlay -->
  <path d='M42 30 L47 16' stroke='#3ec6ff' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M58 30 L53 16' stroke='#3ec6ff' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
